Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**ACADEMY BLOOD HOUND**
*Medium beast, neutral*
**Armor Class** 13
**Hit Points** 33 (5d8 + 10)
**Speed** 40 ft.
**Quality Traits** Keen Sense (Hearing & Smell), Magic Resist
**STR** 14 (+2) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 14 (+2) | **INT** 3 (-4) | **WIS** 14 (+2) | **CHA** 6 (-2)
**Skills** Investigation +2, Perception +4
**Senses** passive Perception 14
**Languages** understands commands in Common but can’t speak
**Challenge Rating** 1 (200 XP) **Prof Bonus** +2

***Magic Sleuth.*** The hound has been trained to track down active spells and magical effects. It can add its proficiency bonus a second time to Wisdom (Perception) checks made to try to observe the source of magical effects (including spells). The dog can sense spells as though it was under the effects of detect magic, and has been trained to relay basic information about spells to its handler through body language.

**ACTIONS**
***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If this attack triggers a Concentration check, that check has disadvantage. If the hound has half its hit points or fewer, it has advantage on this attack and it deals an additional d6 of damage.
